nodes.name: PtNW Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Pt(acac)2 (20 mg), Ni(acac) (30 mg), W(CO)6 (1.6 mg), glucose (135 mg) and 60 mg of polyvinylpyrrolidone (MW 40,000) were dissolved in 1-octadecene (2 ml) and oleylamine (3 ml). After sonicating for 15 min, the solution was sealed with argon. The mixture was then heated to 140 °C for 4 h. The product was centrifuged with ethanol for 15 min, followed by cyclohexane for 20 min. Finally, the product was centrifuged in a mixture of cyclohexane (5 ml) and ethanol (15 ml) for 20 min. The final product was dispersed in ethanol for device preparation.

nodes.source_text: Synthesis of PtNWs... The PtNWs for the ETS measurements were synthesized following a previously reported protocol38. Briefly, Pt(acac)2 (20 mg), Ni(acac) (30 mg), W(CO)6 (1.6 mg), glucose (135 mg) and 60 mg of polyvinylpyrrolidone (MW 40,000) were dissolved in 1-octadecene (2 ml) and oleylamine (3 ml).

nodes.source_text: EIS studies reveal a larger C_dl in the high-potential regime (1.1–0.6 V_RHE) for K+ than for Na+ and Li+... an opposite trend was observed when the potential entered the H_upd/HER regime... the charge-transfer resistance is the lowest for Li+ ions, followed by Na+ and K+ ions

nodes.characterization_summary: CV on stationary polycrystalline Pt disc electrode at 100 mV s^-1 shows H_upd peak more positive in 0.1 M KOH than NaOH and LiOH (inset shows normalized H_upd peak).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Cyclic voltammograms on a stationary polycrystalline Pt disc electrode at a scan rate of 100 mV s^-1 (the inset shows an expanded view of the normalized H_upd peak).

nodes.characterization_summary: HER polarization curves (iR-corrected) at 5 mV s^-1, 1600 rpm show highest activity for Li+, followed by Na+ then K+ on polycrystalline Pt disc electrode.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HER polarization curves (iR-corrected; i, current; R, resistance) collected at room temperature on a polycrystalline Pt disc electrode in N2-saturated 0.1 M MOH (M = Li, Na and K) at a scan rate of 5 mV s^-1 with a rotation speed of 1,600 revolutions per min.

properties.description: Cyanide group mentioned in y-axis label (H-CN)

nodes.characterization_summary: ETS conductance on PtNWs shows less pronounced conductance increase with Li+ compared to Na+ and K+, indicating higher OH_ad coverage with smaller cations in H_upd/HER regime.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the smaller increase in conductance in the presence of Li+ cations suggests that fewer OH_ad are being desorbed or replaced by H2O or H_ad compared with that of the other larger cations.

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows C_dl larger for K+ > Na+ > Li+ above 0.6 V_RHE but Li+ > Na+ > K+ in H_upd/HER regime; R_ct lowest for Li+ in HER regime (<0.4 V_RHE).
nodes.evidence_snippet: in the H_upd and HER regimes (< 0.4 V_RHE), the charge-transfer resistance is the lowest for Li+ ions, followed by Na+ and K+ ions, which consistent with the improved Volmer-step kinetics.
